objective.statement: Prevent fleet-only sccache configuration from leaking into portable Home Manager profiles.
objective.measure: All four profiles evaluate; only cc-se-sto-devbox-01 emits the fleet wrapper and /run/sccache environment.

need.statement: Portable profiles currently inherit a fleet-only wrapper and socket that do not exist on those hosts.
stakeholders: Rust builds on cc-se-sto-devbox-01, mikki-laptop, mikki-bunker, and generic mhugo
need.baseline: home/modules/files.nix and build-cache-maintenance.nix are imported by the common module graph and unconditionally emit fleet sccache settings.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Laptop, bunker, and generic profiles can activate invalid Cargo wrapper and Unix-socket paths.
assumptions: The devbox profile is the sole Home Manager consumer of the fleet host daemon; falsified if a declared non-devbox host documents that daemon contract.
alternatives_considered: Teach every portable host to run the fleet daemon

purpose: Keep fleet-only sccache wrapper and Unix-socket settings off portable Home Manager profiles.
consumer: The four Home Manager profile evaluations and Rust builds run from each profile.
contract: Only cc-se-sto-devbox-01 emits the fleet rustc wrapper plus /run/sccache SCCACHE_DIR and SCCACHE_SERVER_UDS; mikki-laptop, mikki-bunker, and mhugo emit none of those fleet-only settings.
failure_boundary: A failed profile evaluation or leaked fleet setting blocks integration; no live Home Manager activation is part of this lane.

evidence.description: Evaluate the relevant activation/config attributes for all four profiles and assert the exact profile matrix.

executable_check.description: Evaluate all four Home Manager outputs and reject any wrong-profile setting.

non_goals: Changing the fleet system sccache daemon
invariants: All four declared homeConfigurations continue evaluating
Portable profiles retain ordinary Cargo configuration without fleet-only paths

assumptions.statement: Profile-specific module composition can express this split without imperative activation logic.
assumptions.falsifier: flake evaluation shows no profile-specific module boundary.

plane_constraints: Do not activate or publish from this implementation lane.
